# Final Project Milestone 3

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(plotly)

billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard_2026_data.csv")
```

## Genre Breakdown & Performance

```{r}
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-height: 7
genre_stats <- billboard |> 
  slice_head(n = 100) |> 
  group_by(Genre) |> 
  summarize(
    Count = n(),
    Avg_Rank = round(mean(Rank), 1),
    Best_Rank = min(Rank),
    Top_Song = Song[which.min(Rank)],
    Worst_Rank = max(Rank),
    Lowest_Song = Song[which.max(Rank)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Bar_Label = ifelse(Count >= 5, paste0(Count, " songs"), as.character(Count))
  )

p <- ggplot(genre_stats, aes(
  x = Count, 
  y = fct_reorder(Genre, Count),
  fill = Avg_Rank,
  text = paste0(
    "🎵 <b>", Genre, "</b><br>",
    "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━<br>",
    "📊 Songs in Top 100: <b>", Count, "</b><br>",
    "📈 Average Chart Rank: <b>#", Avg_Rank, "</b><br>",
    "⭐ Highest Song: <b>#", Best_Rank, "</b> (", Top_Song, ")<br>",
    "🔻 Lowest Song: <b>#", Worst_Rank, "</b> (", Lowest_Song, ")"
  )
)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.92) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = Count / 2, label = Bar_Label), 
    color = "white", 
    fontface = "bold", 
    size = 3.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#0284c7", "#2563eb", "#6366f1", "#9333ea", "#c084fc"),
    name = "Avg Rank\n(#1 is top)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 100 Genre Breakdown & Performance",
    x = "Number of Songs in Top 100",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#0f172a"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, color = "#1e293b"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#64748b")
  )

ggplotly(p, height = 580, tooltip = "text") |> 
  layout(autosize = TRUE) |> 
  config(responsive = TRUE)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
billboard |> 
  slice_head(n = 100) |> 
  summarize(
    `Average Weeks on Chart` = round(mean(Weeks_on_Chart, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Median Weeks on Chart` = median(Weeks_on_Chart, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Most Weeks on Chart` = max(Weeks_on_Chart, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Songs Reaching #1` = sum(Peak == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  gt()
```

## First 100 Songs

```{r}
billboard |> 
  slice_head(n = 100) |> 
  select(Rank, Cover, Song, Artist, Genre, Last_Week, Peak, Weeks_on_Chart) |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(
    title = "Billboard Hot 100",
    subtitle = "Week of February 7, 2026"
  ) |> 
  cols_label(
    Rank = "#",
    Cover = "",
    Song = "Song",
    Artist = "Artist",
    Genre = "Genre",
    Last_Week = "Last Wk",
    Peak = "Peak",
    Weeks_on_Chart = "Wks on Chart"
  ) |> 
  fmt_image(columns = Cover, height = 45) |> 
  tab_options(table.width = pct(100)) |> 
  opt_interactive(use_pagination = TRUE, page_size_default = 25)
```
